game.title: Neon Lanes
game.objective: Dodge pink block obstacles, jump over orange barriers, and collect as many coins as possible along a 3-lane synthwave highway.
game.controls: Swipe left or right to switch lanes, swipe up to jump over barriers, and tap on-screen buttons to revive or install.
game.core_loop: Swipe to dodge obstacles and jump barriers -> survive at increasing speeds -> collect coins and power-ups to maximize your score.
game.progression: Car speed (SPD) and distance (m) continuously climb throughout the run, demanding quicker reflex dodges.
game.hook_idea: Collecting the Magnet power-up at t=19.4s-21.2s, pulling a stream of gold coins into the car at top speed (SPD 81).
